description:
Improper neutralization of Script-Related HTML tags in a web page (basic XSS) vulnerability in İzometri IT Services Domestic and Foreign Trade Co. Ltd. Eimzamip allows Stored XSS.

This issue affects eimzamip: from v1.6.4 before v1.6.7.
